findings.text: follow-on: crew_list now calls queue_admission.queued_placements, which orders through queue_order.admission_order and raises ValueError("queued pointer has no readable queued_at") at reckon/crew/queue_order.py:36 on any queued pointer lacking it, so one malformed queued pointer now takes down the whole `crew list` listing, a failure mode the listing did not have before; the plan already files this as §34 with its fix in the un-fenced queue_admission.py, so no repair is owed inside this node.

VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/test_queued_work_shows_where_held_work_shows.py::test_crew_list_names_the_queued_runs_place with its expected-failure marker removed, a declared negative control, the population arm over the files importing reckon/crew_run_commands.py, and ruff; logs/gate-head.log records "5 passed in 6.91s" EXIT=0, logs/negative-control.log records the red arm, and both population logs are present.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew_run_commands.py, tests/test_queued_work_shows_where_held_work_shows.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-held-dispatch-waits-its-fair-turn/crew-list-shows-a-queued-runs-place.html and the figures directory; git diff touches the first three, every path inside the declared set.
VERDICT manifest: read; status complete, landing states the change and the gate figure, tests: is the literal pytest command, test_logs names five logs, and baseline_suite/after_suite both record 10 failed and 335 passed over the same eleven ids.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against 0376a2f1b; 1133e7ac2 rewrites the crew_list row into a dict then updates it from `placements`, 72435fc47 adds the evidence fragment, and the test change removes only the xfail decorator and its now-unused pytest import.

JUSTIFICATION reuse: the change consumes the existing owner reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:961 queued_placements rather than ordering the queue itself, reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:44 names it the single place, and reckon/crew/query.py:208 plus reckon/crew/obligations.py:1293 already share it.
